_comment: Pinned model weights for the weights-gated CLIP/SigLIP2 + face parity gate.
Each entry fixes the upstream source by revision AND a sha256 over the file
the gate actually consumes, so an upstream re-publish cannot silently shift
embeddings underneath the parity assertions. ci/fetch_parity_weights.py
downloads at the pinned revision and fails the build on any digest mismatch.
Hosting these as our own artifacts (removing the HuggingFace dependency) is
tracked separately; this file pins against the current upstream sources.
To roll a pin: update revision + sha256 here, regenerate the committed ONNX
goldens (scripts/gen_parity_golden.py), and confirm the gate still passes.

siglip2.note: fp16 pre-converted SigLIP2 served directly by the native MLX backend (no torch).

openai_clip.note: OpenAI CLIP port; the vendored backend converts this pytorch pickle to MLX on a cold cache (torch, convert-only). Pinning the source pickle + the cosine>=0.99 gate together catch any convert drift.

buffalo_l.note: InsightFace recognition pack; w600k_r50.onnx is the ArcFace recognition model the face parity gate exercises.
